  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

CHAIR REMARKS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53174  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Equity and Human Relations
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, April 3, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53175  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Bill Sive regarding LGBT
  Elders Day, and if appropriate, recommend the City Council endorse the community
  forum.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-53176  Recommendation to receive and file presentations from the following organizations:

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:00 PM

  Long Beach Pride, The Center, Transgeneros Unidas from Bienestar, City of Long
  Beach Library Services, and Earthlodge regarding LGBTQ+ Services in Long

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Equity and Human Relations Commission on non-agenda items. Each
